summary.decision: The ten listed ready families pass this bounded visual and mechanical-export review, subject to the WEB-03 adjacent-heading condition and the separate provenance, rights, and publication gates. RUN-01 and RUN-02 remain partial until their square variants receive authored reflows. RUN-03 remains blocked until its wide timeline export receives authored reflow. This decision is not a public deployment or publication approval.
